from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,math,shutil,struct,subprocess,wave
root=Path.cwd(); base=root/'.wac-local/WAC-M3-06/menu'
assert not base.exists(), 'Do not overwrite earlier menu evidence.'
app=base/'app'; app.mkdir(parents=True)
runtime={}
digest=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for p in sorted(root.glob('WinAudioClean*')):
    if p.suffix not in ('.ps1','.bat'): continue
    q=app/p.name;shutil.copyfile(p,q);runtime[p.name]=digest(p)
    assert digest(q)==runtime[p.name]
fixture=base/'synthetic.wav'
with wave.open(str(fixture),'wb') as w:
    w.setnchannels(2);w.setsampwidth(2);w.setframerate(48000)
    values=bytearray()
    for i in range(48000*8):
        t=i/48000; a=0.12*(0.5+0.5*math.sin(2*math.pi*1.7*t)**2)
        left=a*(math.sin(2*math.pi*317*t)+0.25*math.sin(2*math.pi*913*t))
        right=a*(math.sin(2*math.pi*419*t)+0.2*math.sin(2*math.pi*1103*t))
        values.extend(struct.pack('<hh',round(left*32767),round(right*32767)))
    w.writeframes(values)
for host in ('ps51','ps7'):
    for choice in ('1','2'):
        out=base/(host+'-'+choice);out.mkdir()
        config=base/(host+'-'+choice+'-settings.json')
        config.write_text(json.dumps({'schemaVersion':1,'settings':{'outputDirectory':str(out)}}),encoding='utf-8')
tools=root/'.wac-local/ffmpeg-setup/portable-curl/ffmpeg-9.0.2-essentials_build/bin'
state={'baseline':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'runtime':runtime,'fixture_sha256':digest(fixture),'tools':{n:digest(tools/n) for n in ('ffmpeg.exe','ffprobe.exe')},'settings':{p.name:digest(p) for p in base.glob('*-settings.json')},'fixture':'deterministic synthetic stereo tones, eight seconds; no interview or listening evidence'}
(base/'prepared.json').write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'runtimeCount':len(runtime),'fixtureFrames':48000*8,'fixture_sha256':state['fixture_sha256']}))

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess
root=Path.cwd();base=root/'.wac-local/WAC-M3-06/menu';public=root/'docs/codex/winaudioclean/evidence'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
prepared=json.loads((base/'prepared.json').read_text())
capture=json.loads((base/'pty-captures.json').read_text())
ffmpeg=root/'.wac-local/ffmpeg-setup/portable-curl/ffmpeg-9.0.2-essentials_build/bin/ffmpeg.exe'
def clean(s):
    s=re.sub(r'\x1b\][^\x07]*(?:\x07|\x1b\\)','',s)
    s=re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]','',s)
    for old,new in [(str(root),'<repo>'),(str(Path.home()),'<user-profile>')]:
        pattern=r'[\\/]+'.join(re.escape(part) for part in re.split(r'[\\/]+',old))
        s=re.sub(pattern,lambda m:new,s,flags=re.I)
    return '\n'.join(x.rstrip() for x in s.splitlines()).strip()+'\n'
def sanitized(value):
    if isinstance(value,str):return clean(value).strip()
    if isinstance(value,dict):return {k:sanitized(v) for k,v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value,list):return [sanitized(v) for v in value]
    return value
def run(command):
    p=subprocess.run(command,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=60)
    assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')
    commands.append(command)
    return p.stdout
commands=[];cases=[];history=[]
mapping={'menuPs51Choice1':('ps51','1'),'menuPs51Choice2':('ps51','2'),'menuPs7Choice1Corrected':('ps7','1'),'menuPs7Choice2':('ps7','2')}
for row in capture['records']:
    key=row['key'];text=''.join(x['output'] for x in row['chunks'])
    log=public/('WAC-M3-06-menu-'+key+'.txt')
    if log.exists(): assert log.read_text(encoding='utf-8')==clean(text)
    else: log.write_text(clean(text),encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
    info={'id':key,'launch_command':row['cmd'],'terminal_actions':row['actions'],'exit_code':row['finalExit'],'log':log.relative_to(public.parent).as_posix(),'log_sha256':sha(log),'terminal_chunks':len(row['chunks'])}
    if key not in mapping:
        assert row['finalExit']==2 and 'Launcher paths must use an ordinary Windows drive path.' in text
        info['cause']='Root probe Get-Command returned multiple pwsh paths; selected one host with Select-Object -First 1. Runtime unchanged.'
        history.append(info);continue
    host,choice=mapping[key];folder=base/(host+'-'+choice)
    assert row['finalExit']==0
    assert 'Select Processing Mode (Original preset)' in text and '[1] RAW RECORDING' in text and '[2] ZOOM/TEAMS' in text and '[Q] Cancel' in text
    assert 'Press any key to continue' in text
    reports=list(folder.glob('*.json'));waves=list(folder.glob('*.wav'));txts=[p for p in folder.glob('*.txt') if p.name!='WinAudioClean_Log.txt']
    assert len(reports)==len(waves)==len(txts)==1
    assert sha(folder/'WinAudioClean_Log.txt')==sha(txts[0])
    assert not list(folder.glob('*.partial'))
    report=json.loads(reports[0].read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    assert report['status']==report['processingStatus']=='SUCCESS' and report['applicationExitCode']==0
    assert report['reporting']['complete'] and not report['reporting']['errors']
    assert report['presetId']=='original' and report['presetVersion']=='1.0.0'
    assert report['settings']['mode']==('Raw' if choice=='1' else 'Zoom')
    assert report['settings']['loudnessMode']=='Fast' and report['settings']['bitDepth']==16
    assert report['output']['published'] and report['output']['verified']['Frames']==384000
    assert report['output']['verified']['DurationSeconds']==8
    assert report['progress']['currentStage']=='Completed' if 'currentStage' in report['progress'] else True
    ref=base/(host+'-'+choice+'-reference.wav')
    run([str(ffmpeg),'-nostdin','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-n','-i',str(base/'synthetic.wav'),'-map','0:a:0','-vn','-sn','-dn','-af',report['settings']['exactFilters'],'-ar','48000','-acodec','pcm_s16le','-map_metadata','-1','-map_chapters','-1',str(ref)])
    decode=lambda path:run([str(ffmpeg),'-nostdin','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-i',str(path),'-map','0:a:0','-f','s16le','-acodec','pcm_s16le','pipe:1'])
    actual=decode(waves[0]);reference=decode(ref);assert actual==reference and len(actual)==384000*2*2
    info.update({'host':host,'choice':choice,'mode':report['settings']['mode'],'presetId':report['presetId'],'presetVersion':report['presetVersion'],'settings':report['settings'],'outputVerified':report['output']['verified'],'audio_sha256':sha(waves[0]),'report_sha256':sha(reports[0]),'text_report_sha256':sha(txts[0]),'reference_sha256':sha(ref),'exact_pcm_sha256':hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest(),'exact_pcm_match':True,'reporting':report['reporting'],'reportProgress':report['progress']})
    cases.append(info)
assert len(cases)==4
assert all(sha(root/name)==digest==sha(base/'app'/name) for name,digest in prepared['runtime'].items())
assert sha(base/'synthetic.wav')==prepared['fixture_sha256']
assert all(sha(base/name)==digest for name,digest in prepared['settings'].items())
assert all(sha(ffmpeg.parent/name)==digest for name,digest in prepared['tools'].items())
result={'schemaVersion':1,'task':'WAC-M3-06','baseline':prepared['baseline'],'scope':'Actual unmodified BAT/CMD launch, real interactive console Read-Host choices through exec_command PTY, and real pinned FFmpeg. Synthetic media only; supplementary engineering evidence for AC-064, not its manual interview/Explorer acceptance.','counts':{'finalCases':4,'passed':4,'audioAssets':4,'pcmMatches':4,'priorProbeFailures':1},'guards':{'runtimeAndCopyUnchanged':True,'fixtureUnchanged':True,'isolatedSettingsUnchanged':True,'toolsUnchanged':True},'prepared':prepared,'capture':{'path':'.wac-local/WAC-M3-06/menu/pty-captures.json','sha256':sha(base/'pty-captures.json'),'format':'Tool-returned decoded UTF-8 terminal output chunks, including ANSI/OSC repaint controls; tool metadata and input actions retained. Not a direct byte-stream recording.'},'harnesses':{str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in [root/'.wac-local/WAC-M3-06/prepare-menu.py',Path(__file__).resolve()]},'cases':cases,'retainedFailures':history,'referenceAndDecodeCommands':commands,'limitations':['No human interview file supplied; fixture is deterministic synthetic stereo tones.','No Explorer drag-and-drop, picker gesture or human speech-quality listening was performed.','Explicit isolated SettingsPath contains only outputDirectory to keep menu mode unset and avoid actual user Music/preferences.','PTY input was supplied by the agent through write_stdin; this is actual console interaction, not a human UI check.','Exact report-graph PCM matching preserves existing graph delay; it does not establish zero input/output lag.']}
encoded=json.dumps(sanitized(result),indent=2,ensure_ascii=True)+'\n'
assert not re.search(r'C:[\\/]+Users|<user-name>|C:[\\/]+projects',encoded,re.I)
target=public/'WAC-M3-06-menu.json';assert not target.exists();target.write_text(encoded,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'menuCases':4,'exactPcmMatches':4,'retainedFailedProbe':1,'allGuards':True,'publicSha256':sha(target)}))

import hashlib,json,re,shutil
root=Path.cwd();ev=root/'docs/codex/winaudioclean/evidence';archive=root/'.wac-local/WAC-M3-06/menu-public-before-privacy'
assert not archive.exists();archive.mkdir()
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
names=['WAC-M3-06-menu.json','WAC-M3-06-menu-harness.json']+[p.name for p in ev.glob('WAC-M3-06-menu-*.txt')]
for name in names:shutil.copyfile(ev/name,archive/name)
j=json.loads((ev/'WAC-M3-06-menu.json').read_text());changes=[]
for row in j['cases']+j['retainedFailures']:
    p=ev.parent/row['log'];old=sha(p);assert old==row['log_sha256']
    text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

    assert not re.search(r'(?i)[A-Z]:[\\/]',fixed)
    if count:p.write_text(fixed,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
    row['log_sha256']=sha(p)
    changes.append({'log':row['log'],'before_sha256':old,'after_sha256':sha(p),'fragment_replacements':count})

Generic remaining Windows drive-path fragments are now redacted.
